title: Array sum and average reference solution
answer:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { int values[]={2,4,6}; size_t n=sizeof values/sizeof values[0]; int sum=0; for(size_t i=0;i<n;++i) sum+=values[i]; printf("sum=%d avg=%.2f\n",sum,(double)sum/(double)n); return 0; }
explanation: This reference illustrates one possible implementation, not the only acceptable solution. Review integer range, input validation, ownership/lifetime, compiler warnings and target-platform assumptions as appropriate.
